title: assay.ledger-push/1
description: One line of a push file `pushes/<repo_id>/<pr>.jsonl` in the ledger repository (docs/architecture/06-operations.md §1, 02-architecture.md §5, 03-contracts.md §6c), appended by `open`: an `opener` record for `opened` (the head the PR arrived with; its sender is the opener, never a pusher, and it has no `before` and is never `forced`) and a `push` record for each `synchronize` (with `before`). `seq` is 1 for the first line and one more on each next one (the pending stamp's `seq`); `at` is the push clock; one record per `run_uid`; `run_uid.repo_id` and `pr` are the file's. Unknown fields are rejected.

sender_id.description: Who sent the event, by numeric GitHub id: a pusher is never an eligible approver (P10); an opener is not a pusher.

time.description: A UTC instant to the millisecond, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ`.
